color.source_note: NEOWISE/AllWISE single-exposure catalog profile fits, per-visit medians; target saturated in the images

plain: No motion detected over 17 years (less than about 0.09 arcseconds per year): a distant star, a galaxy, or too slow to see.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = 1.02 mag is red, as for early-T and the reddest L brown dwarfs (dusty or very cool stars can look like this too).
Whether its brightness changes cannot be told: the star is saturated in WISE: catalog brightness values are not reliable enough.
Not enough clean SPHEREx measurements to read its spectrum.
